name: Wanted [🎃UPDATE]
desc:
💰 Live life as a daring bank robber or fight criminals and bring justice to Oasis City. 

The Wanted Halloween event has kicked off! 🎃
🧟 Fight waves of zombies in the badlands for bones!
🏎️ New Reaper & Rattler vehicles!
💰 New Ghost Bag quest!
🗺️ New fall map with a big secret...

See the patch notes in-game for a full list of changes!

Earn cash and complete missions to unlock faster cars, stronger weapons, and a bigger base. Crimes increase your wanted level and put a bounty on your head.

Will you uncover the secrets of the Oasis?
